title: · In Focus | lululemon Unveils Fall/Winter 2026 Outerwear Collection: Step Outside and Embrace the Energy of Winter ·
original_title: 特写 | lululemon 发布2026秋冬外套系列：走出去，感受冬日生动
excerpt: Lululemon unveils its Fall/Winter 2026 outerwear collection with a campaign starring Li Yuchun and Lewis Hamilton, promoting all-weather movement and outdoor calm.
author: 撰稿 X Vivi 编辑 X RAN

blocks.text: Athletic lifestyle brand lululemon has just unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 outerwear collection, fronted by a new campaign starring five ambassadors, among them singer, songwriter and actor Li Yuchun and seven-time F1 world champion Lewis Hamilton. The lens turns on the new Featherweight™ and other outerwear lines, encouraging wearers to move through any kind of weather with ease, take in the vitality of the outdoors, and rediscover a sense of calm.
Brand ambassador Lewis Hamilton in the Featherweight™ down jacket

At lululemon, we're always attuned to unmet needs and build high-quality products around them. This time, we've taken fabrics and technologies usually reserved for alpine environments and brought them into versatile, elegantly designed outerwear that carries our guests effortlessly through every part of the day. —JJ Collier, Vice President of Outerwear Design at lululemon

The Fall/Winter 2026 outerwear collection carries forward lululemon's commitment to fit, feel and performance in athletic wear, pairing a refined hand feel with functional performance. The new Featherweight™ down jacket is filled with 900-fill-power goose down, making it as light as a cloud while delivering cozy warmth; a water-repellent shell handles shifting weather, and a built-in stuff sack lets it pack down easily for light, go-anywhere carrying.
Brand ambassador Li Yuchun in the lululemon global Fall/Winter outerwear campaign

What makes the Featherweight™ down jacket so special is that it's warm, light and freeing—and easy to pack. It lets me slip it on and off freely, with that ready-to-go-anytime feeling. —Li Yuchun, lululemon brand ambassador

With fall and winter weather so changeable, lululemon also offers warm options for damp, cold conditions. The ThermoZen™ collection brings an easy urban style in clean lines, with a silky-smooth Glyde™ fabric paired with an upgraded PrimaLoft® Gold insulation for a warm, enveloping feel; the relaxed long silhouette layers easily, creating an effortless winter look with just the right balance. The Insulated stand-collar jacket is made with a taffeta shell and PrimaLoft® insulation that stays warm even when wet, while its oversized cut and high stand collar leave room for the body to move freely.

The Wunder Puff™ down collection uses 600-fill-power goose down along with a water-repellent, wind-resistant SoftMatte fabric. This season brings an updated fit with more room in the arms and cleaner, sharper lines. Wunder Puff™ also adds a new down bomber jacket and vest, delivering the same light, warm and comfortable feel alongside winter-ready style.
lululemon ambassadors in the Wunder Puff™ collection

The global Fall/Winter 2026 outerwear campaign launches across online channels and stores nationwide from September 29, including the newly opened lululemon Shanghai New World New Maru Centre store. The recently refreshed lululemon Chengdu Taikoo Li store exclusively presents brand ambassador Li Yuchun's "Winter Picks," spanning the Featherweight™ down collection she personally fronts as well as more fall and winter pieces that express her personal style.
Brand ambassador Li Yuchun in the lululemon global Fall/Winter outerwear campaign

From September 30, the Featherweight™ style installation makes stops at Chengdu Taikoo Li East Plaza and then Beijing Sanlitun Taikoo Li South Plaza, showcasing a range of distinctive winter looks. In addition, Shanghai's Anfu Road plays host for the first time to a combination of large-scale wall mural and oversized billboard featuring Li Yuchun's Featherweight™ down campaign, bringing a light, richly layered touch of winter charm to a familiar street corner.
